_how_to_use: Copy this file. Replace every FILL IN and every null. Then run: python3 earth2/deepdives/merge_nodes.py public/future/earth2/graph.json YOUR_FILE.json --dry-run . The merge refuses and lists exactly what is still missing. One line of guidance per field: earth2/templates/README.md

graph.short_name: FILL IN: a short name for this load, for example water arm Dec 3
graph.origin: FILL IN: where the link strengths come from, for example water arm Dec 3 (A to about B, estimate)
graph.created: FILL IN: YYYY-MM-DD, the date of this load
graph.note: FILL IN: one line on what this adds and why
new_arms: FILL IN: THE ARM NAME IN CAPITALS (delete this list when the arm already exists)

nodes.label: FILL IN: the end event as one plain sentence with its threshold and date
nodes.arm: FILL IN: THE ARM NAME IN CAPITALS
nodes.status: FILL IN: ON TRACK for a new event
nodes.window_start: FILL IN: YYYY-MM-DD, the first day it could happen
nodes.window_peak: FILL IN: YYYY-MM-DD, the most likely day
nodes.window_end: FILL IN: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the odds are measured to
nodes.date_state: FILL IN: LOCKED, SCHEDULED or ESTIMATED
nodes.date_catalyst: FILL IN: the dated catalyst behind the peak, or delete this line
nodes.least_capability: FILL IN: the least thing that has to be true for this to become easy
nodes.source: FILL IN: where this event and its odds come from
nodes.next_watch: FILL IN: the next dated thing to watch
nodes.settlement_test: FILL IN: the exact, checkable fact that settles this event yes or no

base_rate.reference_class: FILL IN: the group of past cases this event belongs to
base_rate.source: FILL IN: where the base rate was counted

nodes.kill_condition: FILL IN: one dated, observable fact that would rule this event out
nodes.kill_check: FILL IN: the named data series, filing or official source to check for that fact

nodes.label: FILL IN: the step on the way, as one plain sentence
nodes.arm: FILL IN: THE ARM NAME IN CAPITALS
nodes.status: FILL IN: ON TRACK for a new event
nodes.date_state: FILL IN: LOCKED, SCHEDULED or ESTIMATED
nodes.least_capability: FILL IN: the least thing that has to be true for this step to become easy
nodes.source: FILL IN: where this step and its odds come from
nodes.settlement_test: FILL IN: the exact, checkable fact that settles this step yes or no

nodes.name: FILL IN: the company name
nodes.listed_options_basis: FILL IN: where and when listed options were checked

links.kind: FILL IN: NECESSARY, LIKELY, MAGNIFIES or OPPOSES
links.reason: FILL IN: why the source moves the target, with the three numbers (A now, B now, B if A fires)

questions.text: FILL IN: a yes or no question about a dated step, answerable from one source
questions.test: FILL IN: the exact rule that makes the answer YES; anything else is NO
questions.source: FILL IN: the named primary source the answer will be read from
questions.script_side: FILL IN: YES or NO, the answer that moves toward the end event
questions.due: FILL IN: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the answer can be read; it never changes
questions.odds_basis: FILL IN: where the odds of YES come from
